CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents.

COD.rationale: Content (color at coordinates), an explicit organization/origin entry, and a separate status-like origin field are present and bound to the same p0/current/n0 referent.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the identified contents' presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify colors bound to coordinates.

D.rationale: The report separately lists identified content (color at coordinates) and a separate origin/organization/status field for the same referent.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

O.rationale: The text specifies how contents are organized/accessed (current vs candidate, origin metadata and peak description).
